hook: A simple online matching algorithm beats the one-half barrier at 0.5445 with random edge arrivals
hook_turn: beats the one-half barrier at 0.5445 with random edge arrivals
summary: In online matching, edges arrive at random times and each must be accepted or rejected immediately. A three-phase algorithm that deliberately rejects some early edges reaches ratio 0.5445 on general graphs and 0.5535 on triangle-free ones, improving a guarantee only slightly above 1/2 that stood nearly a decade. A separate upper bound shows no algorithm can exceed about 0.70, so a gap remains.
title: Improved Bounds for Online Matching with Random Edge Arrivals
